criteria.reason: Clear Fermi-style steps: population, segments, cups per segment, explicit multiplication, sum; no leaps.
Segment shares labeled as estimates, but population given as unsourced fact; data/assumption split not explicit.
Gives ±20% margin, but unjustifiably tight; reported per-capita ~3 cups/day means estimate off roughly 2.5x.
No sources cited for any input; population figure outdated and unsourced.

factual_errors: Population stated as 8.8 million; actual end-2025 permanent resident population was 9,127,100.
Claimed ±20% accuracy, but reported Swiss per-capita consumption (~1,069 cups/year, ~3/day) implies roughly 27-31 million cups/day, far outside the response's 10.65 million estimate.
summary: Systematic Fermi estimate with visible steps and labeled assumptions, but anchored on an outdated unsourced population, citing no sources, and claiming a ±20% margin that excludes the true value by roughly 2.5x.
